# Let's check typical values of mpg for 4 cylinders.
# Most 4-cylinder cars have mpg between 20 and 40, average is around 29.3.
# 43.93 is way too high (max mpg in Auto MPG is 46.6, very few cars have > 40).
# Let's verify how many cars have cylinders == 4: typically ~204.
# If candidate says 43.93014705882353, could it be something else?
print('Sample mean:', df['mpg'].mean())
"}
